URL 파싱 51: 52: | 입력 | 매칭 | 53: |---|---| 54: | `https://tickets.interpark.com/goods/` | platform=interpark | 55: | `https://ticket.yes24.com/Perf/` | platform=yes24 | 56: | `https://ticket.yes24.com/New/Perf/Detail/View/` | platform=yes24 | 57: | `yes24:` / `interpark:` | shorthand | 58: 59: ### 2. 일정 조회 (`schedule`) 60: 61: ```bash 62: npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill@0 exec ticket-availability scripts/ticket_availability.py -- schedule "https://tickets.interpark.com/goods/26000541" 63: ``` 64: 65: 응답 — Interpark: 66: ```json 67: { 68: "platform": "interpark", 69: "id": "26000541", 70: "schedule": [ 71: {"date": "2026-05-13", "time": "14:30", "play_seq": "055"}, 72: {"date": "2026-05-14", "time": "19:30", "play_seq": "057"} 73: ] 74: } 75: ``` 76: 77: 응답 — YES24: 78: ```json 79: { 80: "platform": "yes24", 81: "id": "58026", 82: "schedule": [ 83: {"date": "2026-05-16", "time_label": "1회", "id_time": "1432397"} 84: ] 85: } 86: ``` 87: 88: YES24 는 기본 3주 윈도우. 6개월 전체는 `--all-dates` 추가. 89: 90: ### 3. 잔여석 조회 (`seats`) 91: 92: ```bash 93: npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill@0 exec ticket-availability scripts/ticket_availability.py -- seats "interpark:26000541" 94: ``` 95: 96: 응답: 97: ```json 98: { 99: "platform": "interpark", 100: "id": "26000541", 101: "seats": { 102: "2026-05-13|14:30|055": { 103: "date": "2026-05-13", "time": "14:30", "play_seq": "055", 104: "seats": [ 105: {"grade": "VIP석", "remain": 150}, 106: {"grade": "R석", "remain": 36}, 107: {"grade": "S석", "remain": 82}, 108: {"grade": "A석", "remain": 71} 109: ] 110: } 111: } 112: } 113: ``` 114: 115: YES24 응답은 등급별 `price` (노출가) 도 포함: 116: ```json 117: {"grade": "전석", "price": "110,000원", "remain": 2} 118: ``` 119: 120: ### 4. 헬스체크 (`health`) 121: 122: ```bash 123: npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill@0 exec ticket-availability scripts/ticket_availability.py -- health 124: ``` 125: 126: 응답: 127: ```json 128: {"yes24": {"status": 200, "ok": true}, "interpark": {"status": 200, "ok": true}} 129: ``` 130: 131: ##
